data.name: MSGPlusX
data.subtitle: Messenger tweak by Dens0r & lucaspedrosa (unofficial build)
data.localizedDescription: MSGPlusX is a tweaked Facebook Messenger build (MessengerPlus lineage by Dens0r and lucaspedrosa), distributed ready-to-sideload through the IPA Vault on a current Messenger base version. The tweak's feature set is defined by its build; no official public documentation exists.

compatibility.notes: UNOFFICIAL BUILD. MSGPlusX has no public repository or developer feed - the IPA Vault source is the only distribution channel, so no developer-published download link exists to verify. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta. Uses the stock Messenger bundle identifier, so installing it REPLACES the App Store Messenger on device. SNMessenger shares the same stock Messenger bundle id, so those two install over each other one at a time; Messenger Flow keeps its own id and can stay installed.
